row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (custom pricing by contract volume, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Juro's pricing page says "We'll create a custom plan that works for your business", and its help centre says Juro offers "SCIM for Okta and Microsoft customers specifically", switched on by contacting the Juro Support Team.
row.notes: Status changed from partial (pilot draft) to gated under the post-pilot rules: SCIM works with two IdPs (Okta and Microsoft Entra), so it is not partial, and every Juro plan is a custom, sales-quoted plan, so SCIM needs a Contact Sales plan. New row (no June status). Juro publishes no tier table: plans are priced by contract volume and integrations, with unlimited users, so there is no team plan or per-user price to compare. SCIM must be switched on by Juro Support. Entra uses a non-gallery app pointed at https://app.juro.com/xapi/scim. Okta OIN app supports SAML and SCIM (create, update, deactivate, group push). IdP deactivation removes the user from all Juro groups rather than disabling the account. Other IdPs (JumpCloud, OneLogin) get SAML SSO plus JIT into one default group. The public REST API covers templates and contracts only, not users.

auth.token_source: Juro Connectors / Integrations > SCIM Provisioning (after Juro Support enables it); Juro provides a unique API key used as the IdP secret token

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivating the user or removing app access in Okta/Microsoft removes the user from all assigned groups in the Juro organization; the docs do not say the Juro account is disabled or deleted.

core: userName (updates not supported: a changed userName creates a new user)

roles.how: Okta Push Groups 'Link Group' to Juro's system Organization admins group, or to <Workspace> Admins/Editors/Users groups, to grant org-admin or per-workspace roles

limitations.text: SCIM can be enabled for Okta and Microsoft (Entra, Azure) customers only.
SCIM is not self-serve: the SCIM PROVISIONING panel says Get in touch and Juro Support must enable it.
userName updates are not supported (a new user is created instead); the email attribute is not supported.
Microsoft: direct user assignment does not trigger changes in Juro; permissions only flow through group assignment.
Import New Users and Import Groups work with Okta only.
Pushing membership for a user not yet provisioned returns a 409 error; the Organization admins system group cannot be created or renamed via SCIM.

The public Juro API v3 (https://api.juro.com/v3) documents health, templates and contracts endpoints only; there are no user, member or group endpoints, and webhooks cover contract events. 'available: false' is read from that complete reference, not from an explicit statement.
For the contracts API itself, quotas depend on whether 'API & Webhooks' is on the order form: 100 requests per month without it, 20,000 per day with it.

open_questions: Juro publishes no plan tiers, so which contracts include SSO and SCIM (and at what price) is not public; the pricing page only says SSO is configured as part of a custom plan.
No SCIM API reference is published: endpoints, SCIM version, auth header format, filtering, pagination, supported attributes and rate limits are undocumented.
Whether PATCH or PUT is used for profile updates is not documented.

IdP deactivation removes the user from all Juro groups; whether the Juro account is disabled, whether sessions are revoked, and whether the user can still sign in is not documented. Delete and reactivate are not documented.

Whether SSO must be configured before SCIM is not stated outright: the Microsoft SCIM steps reuse the SAML app created for SSO and the Okta SCIM steps use the same OIN app, but no sentence says SCIM requires SSO.

Microsoft Learn has no Juro tutorial (juro-tutorial and juro-provisioning-tutorial return 404), consistent with Juro's non-gallery instructions. Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue listings were not verified (JumpCloud returned Access Denied).
No admin/user-management API, audit log API or user-event webhooks are documented; CSV user import was not found.
